title: Paragliding: from first flight to instructor
intro: Start with your first flights at a BHPA school, then work up the pilot ratings. From there you can coach at your club, train as an instructor or fly competitions. Every step is here in order.

links.label: British Hang Gliding and Paragliding Association (BHPA)

items.summary: Learn to paraglide in the UK. Then work up the ratings.
Elementary Pilot and Club Pilot: from first hop to flying solo.
BHPA Pilot rating: get qualified to fly cross-country.
BHPA Advanced Pilot: the top paragliding rating.

sections.title: Coach track
sections.intro: Club Coach needs Club Pilot (step 2) plus 10 hours on the hill or 50 tow flights. Senior Coach needs the Pilot rating (step 3).

items.summary: BHPA Club Coach and Senior Coach: help new pilots progress.

sections.title: Instructor track
sections.intro: Needs the Pilot rating (step 3) plus 25 launches.

items.summary: BHPA paragliding Instructor and Senior Instructor: teach new pilots.
